coverage.basis: A security appears here when a document published by the issuer, held in the terminal's own filing corpus, names a customer, supplier, competitor or partner and states the relationship, OR when a web source read on 2026-10-13 names one. Every web entity carries the URL it was read at, the date it was read and the sentence it was read from, and that sentence is also stored in static_data/web_sources/ so the claim can be checked on disk. Nothing is inferred from a sector label and no peer set is generated: if no source names a competitor, this file has none. 'page' is the 1-based page of the named PDF. 'fiscalYear' is the end year of the period the document covers, or the year a web source was read. Top holders are not repeated here; they are read from shareholders_JSE.json.
coverage.sectorPeers: Where an issuer names no competitor in any filing, its competitors column carries the other listings on the same board in the same sector. This is stated in each record's basis so a sector peer is never mistaken for a competitor the issuer disclosed.
coverage.peerVsCompetitor: A record flagged peer:true is another listing on the same board in the same sector. It is a stock-market peer, NOT a business competitor: sharing a sector tag does not mean the two firms compete for the same customers. Only unflagged competitor records name a firm as a competitor - from the Central Bank of Kenya tier ranking, a Competition Authority of Kenya filing, or published market-share coverage.
